Bayes' theorem allows me to update my prior probabilities (which were all 25%) with the likelihoods of the data to get posterior probabilities.

Bayes' theorem is:

P(Machine | Data) = [P(Data | Machine) * P(Machine)] / P(Data)

Where P(Data) is the total probability of the data across all machine types.
